name: Nextcloud Bookmarks
tagline: A front end for the Nextcloud Bookmark app
blurb: A fully open-source Nextcloud Bookmark app.
description:
A fully open-source Nextcloud Bookmark app.

An App for the Nextcloud/Owncloud Bookmark App. With this app you can add, edit, delete and view bookmarks that are synced with your Nextcloud.
You need to have the Bookmarks-App with minimal required version 0.10.1 installed and enabled on your Nextcloud-Instance.
If you need more information about the Nextcloud Bookmark app, you can follow this link.

Features:
• Organize your bookmarks with labels 🔖

• Manage tags 🏷

• Translated in many languages 🌎

• Multiple accounts

• ☑ now showing bookmarks in your Folders 📁

• Nextcloud Single Sign On 🔊 🔥. Needs nextcloud files app as dependency.
